Name: Chambre De Commerce Franco-tcheque / Francouzsko-česká Obchodní Komora
Company description: The French - Czech Chamber of Commerce (CCFT – Chambre de commerce franco-tchèque) was founded in March 1996. Its mission is to be a platform for the French-Czech community development, to promote business and cultural relations between the two countries and their people and to spread the idea of European unity. For its member companies and partners, the CCFT team organizes debate lunches, thematic clubs and conferences, Speed business meetings in Prague and other regions, cultural and networking evenings, as well as pétanque and golf tournaments and different sports trainings. More than 3550 participants attended 69 events organized by CCFT in 2015. The Business Support Department offers a comprehensive range of services to Czech and French companies wishing to enter the foreign market. More than 80 companies are accompanied by the Business Support Department every year. The CCFT is a member of the CCI France International network, which brings together 113 French Chambers of Commerce abroad. The CCFT has built up a network of preferred partners with local and regional chambers of commerce, various economic promotion agencies or territorial jurisdictions in order to have the best sources of information.
